data:
[Abstract]

The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English- to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

brand.title: Linear
brand.description: Linear is a product development platform designed for modern teams and AI‑augmented workflows. It provides a fast, purpose‑built system for planning, tracking, and shipping software, integrating issue tracking, project roadmaps, and real‑time collaboration. Linear’s AI agents help automate tasks such as drafting PRDs, triaging feedback, and pushing pull requests, while its speed‑focused UI reduces noise and accelerates launch cycles. The platform syncs with tools like Slack, GitHub, and customer feedback channels, turning conversations into actionable issues that are automatically labeled, prioritized, and assigned. By combining a clean interface with intelligent automation, Linear enables product teams to move from idea to release with high velocity and clear alignment.
brand.slogan: Build product development workflows for teams and AI agents

brand.title: Vercel
brand.description: Vercel is a cloud platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and scale web applications, AI‑driven agents, and serverless services. Through its Agent Stack—including an AI SDK, AI Gateway, sandboxed environments, and workflow tools—Vercel lets teams create autonomous agents that can investigate errors, plan fixes, and open pull requests. Its core platform provides global content delivery, fluid compute, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and robust security features such as WAF and bot management. Supporting popular frameworks like Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and FastAPI, Vercel offers seamless integration, domain management, custom SSL, and preview URLs, empowering developers to ship anything from marketing sites to complex commerce platforms with instant scalability from zero to millions of users.
brand.slogan: The platform where humans and AI agents build, ship, and scale software.

brand.title: Apple
brand.description: Apple is a global technology company that designs, manufactures, and sells consumer electronics, software, and services. Its product lineup includes the Mac family of computers, iPad tablets, iPhone smartphones, Apple Watch wearables, Vision Pro mixed‑reality headset, AirPods audio devices, and a range of Home products such as Apple TV and HomePod. Apple also offers accessories, refurbished devices, and specialized solutions for education, business, veterans, and government. Through services like iCloud+, Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Arcade, and Apple Fitness+, the company provides integrated digital experiences. Apple supports customers with trade‑in, financing, personal setup, and extensive support resources, while maintaining a retail presence both online and in physical stores worldwide.

brand.title: Stripe
brand.description: Stripe is a technology company that provides economic infrastructure for businesses of all sizes, enabling them to accept online and in‑person payments, manage recurring billing, handle invoices, and access a suite of financial services such as treasury, capital, and crypto solutions. Its platform includes pre‑built checkout, customizable UI components, payment links, and a global network of payment methods. Stripe also offers tools for marketplaces and platforms through Connect, fraud protection via Radar, and developer‑friendly APIs and SDKs. By integrating payments, revenue operations, and money‑management products, Stripe helps companies launch, scale, and automate commerce worldwide.
brand.slogan: Build the economic infrastructure for AI.

results.name: LinkedIn
results.description: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional networking site, founded in 2003. It enables members to create business connections, search for jobs, and find potential clients, fostering a community of career opportunities, advice, and inspiration. With over 1 billion members globally, including executives from every Fortune 500 company, LinkedIn aims to make professionals more productive and successful. The company generates revenue through its Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices worldwide, LinkedIn is a premier platform for managing professional identity, building and engaging with professional networks, and accessing valuable knowledge, insights, and opportunities.

results.name: LINE
results.description: LINE Corporation, based in Japan, develops and operates the LINE messaging app, a global communication platform offering free messaging, voice and video calls, expressive stickers, a personal timeline, and a suite of family apps such as games and camera, serving users in 230 countries.

results.name: Linkmake
results.description: LinkMake is a link protection service that helps users safeguard their links from being compromised. They provide a secure way to share links by using their Link Protector tool, making it difficult for others to access or misuse the original link.

results.name: Arch Linux
results.description: Arch Linux is a lightweight, flexible Linux distribution that follows the KISS (Keep It Simple) principle. It provides officially maintained packages for x86‑64 and a community‑driven repository (AUR) that expands the software ecosystem. The project offers extensive documentation through its wiki, forums, mailing lists, and IRC channels, fostering a diverse and helpful community. Users can download the latest ISO releases, access security updates, and contribute to development via GitLab and various community projects. Arch Linux emphasizes user control, rolling releases, and a minimalist base system that can be customized for any purpose, from desktops to servers.

results.description: Firebase is a Google‑backed development platform that offers a suite of tools and services for building, improving, and growing mobile and web applications. Its features include real‑time databases, cloud storage, authentication, hosting, analytics, and Dynamic Links—a service that creates smart URLs that work across platforms and direct users to the appropriate content or app store. By handling deep linking, user onboarding, and cross‑platform navigation, Firebase helps developers deliver seamless experiences and accelerate app growth.

results.name: Linternaute
results.description: Linternaute.com is a French digital media portal that aggregates a wide range of content for everyday life. It delivers up‑to‑date news covering politics, society, world events, sports and culture, while also offering specialized sections on finance, automotive, high‑tech, DIY, travel, health, lifestyle, and entertainment. The site features product guides, shopping deals, TV programming, dictionaries, genealogy tools, forums and community features such as “Copains d'avant.” By combining editorial articles, expert reviews, practical advice and interactive community spaces, Linternaute serves as a comprehensive online destination for French‑speaking users seeking information, inspiration and tools for informed decisions across all aspects of daily life.

results.name: Linkvertise
results.description: Linkvertise is a monetization platform that enables creators and publishers to earn revenue by sharing short links to downloadable content, applications, and other online resources. Users browse a vast library of over 15 million links, while the service tracks clicks and payouts, providing a dashboard for creators to monitor earnings, manage links, and access analytics. Linkvertise offers a secure, privacy‑focused environment with clear terms and policies, allowing both advertisers and content creators to benefit from a performance‑based advertising model.

results.name: Linköping University
results.description: Linköping University (LiU) is a research‑intensive Swedish university offering a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across its four campuses. It combines interdisciplinary education with cutting‑edge research in fields such as AI, health, energy, and autonomous systems. LiU collaborates with industry, public sector, and international partners to translate scientific discoveries into societal benefits, while supporting lifelong learning and career development for its 50,000 students and staff. The university is recognized among the top 2 % of global institutions, boasts a high graduate employment rate, and provides extensive resources including modern labs, digital platforms, and a vibrant campus community.

results.name: L'Indépendant
results.description: Lindependant.fr is a regional digital media company serving Perpignan and the wider Pyrénées‑Orientales area. It operates an online news portal that aggregates local, national and international headlines across topics such as politics, economy, sports, culture, health and environment. The site also provides a comprehensive events calendar, podcasts, video content, and real‑time traffic updates. In addition to editorial coverage, Lindependant.fr hosts classified ads, legal notices, real‑estate listings, job postings and marketplace services for businesses and private users. By combining news, community information and commercial services, the platform aims to be the primary source of information and a hub for daily life in the Catalan‑French region.
